Occurrences.Kwic: 且有幾箇到此境界不敢望你言中有響句裏藏鋒瞬目千差風恬浪靜伏惟尚饗。問如何是透法身句師云北斗裏藏身。問如何是本來宗師云不問

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120) (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Speaker: Yangqi Fanghui.

Senses.Explanation: May you deign to accept this offering is a formal sacrificial closing repurposed as a deliberately non-expository reply. Records preserve both its ritual lament use and masters' abrupt use of the formula where an explanation is refused or cut off.
